_comment: Who gets a position series of their own. A track earns its place by separating
from the party at some point — otherwise its positions are just Fogg's, and a
second copy of the same numbers is a liability rather than a feature.
Aliases are matched under match_key, so case and typography do not matter.

tracks.why: the map's primary series — the wager is his, and the route is his itinerary
separated from the party at Yokohama, chapters 23/24/27 — a series of its own
reaches Suez ahead of the party in chapter 6, which is exactly why a forward-only rule over places_visited is not enough

not_a_track.name: Aouda
not_a_track.why: travels with Fogg from chapter 13 onwards but never separately — her position is his, and a duplicate series would only be another thing to keep in step

not_a_track.name: Sir Francis Cromarty
not_a_track.why: accompanies the party across India only, and never apart from it

not_a_track.name: Rowan
not_a_track.why: the commissioner of police; appears in chapter 5 reading a telegram and never travels
